question: In Economics, 'multiplier' is defined as the ratio of increase in income to increase in ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is** __investment__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **multiplier** is a **numerical coefficient** that illustrates how changes in **total national investment** affect **total national income ** in economics, 
 
• It is equivalent to the **proportion** of changes in **investments **to the changes in** overall revenue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **multiplie**r's magnitude is determined by the **proportion** of deposits that **banks** must retain in their **reserves**.
 
• The **money supply reserve multiplier** rises when the reserve requirement is decreased and falls the opposite way.
 
• The **fiscal multiplier** measures the relationship between an increase in a nation's **national income** and the original **increase in expenditure or decrease in taxes** that generated that income.
